WITH ball_data AS (
    SELECT 
        bs.match_id,
        bs.innings_no,
        b.striker,
        b.non_striker,
        bs.runs_scored,
        b.ball_id,
        b.over_id
    FROM batsman_scored bs
    JOIN ball_by_ball b ON bs.match_id = b.match_id AND bs.over_id = b.over_id AND bs.ball_id = b.ball_id AND bs.innings_no = b.innings_no
),
partnership AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        innings_no,
        striker as p1_player_id,
        non_striker as p2_player_id,
        SUM(runs_scored) as partnership_runs
    FROM ball_data
    GROUP BY match_id, innings_no, striker, non_striker
),
individual_scores AS (
    SELECT 
        match_id,
        innings_no,
        player_id,
        SUM(runs_scored) as individual_score
    FROM (
        SELECT match_id, innings_no, striker as player_id, runs_scored FROM ball_data
        UNION ALL
        SELECT match_id, innings_no, non_striker as player_id, runs_scored FROM ball_data
    )
    GROUP BY match_id, innings_no, player_id
),
partnered_pairs AS (
    SELECT 
        p.match_id,
        p.innings_no,
        p.p1_player_id as player1_id,
        p.p2_player_id as player2_id,
        p.partnership_runs,
        COALESCE(i1.individual_score, 0) as player1_score,
        COALESCE(i2.individual_score, 0) as player2_score
    FROM partnership p
    LEFT JOIN individual_scores i1 ON p.match_id = i1.match_id AND p.innings_no = i1.innings_no AND p.p1_player_id = i1.player_id
    LEFT JOIN individual_scores i2 ON p.match_id = i2.match_id AND p.innings_no = i2.innings_no AND p.p2_player_id = i2.player_id
),
ranked_partnerships AS (
    SELECT 
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, innings_no ORDER BY partnership_runs DESC) as rn
    FROM partnered_pairs
),
ordered_pairs AS (
    SELECT 
        *,
        CASE 
            WHEN player1_score > player2_score THEN player1_id
            WHEN player2_score > player1_score THEN player2_id
            ELSE GREATEST(player1_id, player2_id)
        END as player1,
        CASE 
            WHEN player1_score > player2_score THEN player2_id
            WHEN player2_score > player1_score THEN player1_id
            ELSE LEAST(player1_id, player2_id)
        END as player2
    FROM ranked_partnerships
)
SELECT 
    match_id,
    player1,
    player2,
    player1_score,
    player2_score,
    partnership_runs
FROM ordered_pairs
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY match_id
